title.narrative: START Hub NNGO Organisational Strengthening South Sudan

description.narrative: In consortium with Christian Aid, CTP will provide organisational strengthening for the four NNGO members of the South Sudan START Hub. CAFOD is able to provide extensive experience and materials from its history as a champion of capacity strengthening for local NGOs and will continue to work towards the localisation objectives of the START Hub. The project approach will ensure the capacity strengthening needs of all partners are addressed in both a coordinated as well as tailored manner, achieving value for money for the entire project implementation. To reflect this, CAFOD and CA will commit to sharing half of the project’s indirect admin costs with participating organisations. Therefore, as the project develops the partners’ implementation plans will be further addressed through two broad categories: • Centrally coordinated capacity strengthening supports: Some commonly identified organisational priorities of the four partner organisations will be centrally coordinated by CAFOD for better efficiency. • Partner Specific Capacity strengthening supports: partners that have capacity gaps specific to their respective organisations will be addressed separately, led by partners with the accompaniment and mentoring support of CAFOD. The organisational change processes across all the nine priority capacity streams in the START DD assessment tool will be prioritised and supported at different level: • Staff on technical skill and knowledge development • Supporting the development and review of policies, manuals, guidelines, standards, etc • Supporting the establishment of relevant organisational systems and processes • Availability of the required asset bases
